summary: Page 1 and Page 2 geometry follow the official Jan 2018 ENCS PDF closely, but Item 1 Date of Transaction and Schedule 2 Item 1B print blank, Schedule 1.A rows 6-15 are silently dropped with no overflow page, Part III Details of Payment is missing on screen, and 66 raw developer cell IDs appear as field labels in forms/forms-schema.json.

defects.what: Item 1 Date of Transaction prints completely blank even when filled.

defects.where: Page 2 Schedule 2 Item 1B (Total Fair Market Value of Land and Improvement per Schedule 1.A)
defects.what: Continuation of Schedule 1.A TOTAL prints 10,188,148,170.74, but Schedule 2 Item B prints blank.
Screen form has 15 filled Schedule 1.A rows, but print preview outputs only 2 pages (rows 1-5) and silently drops rows 6-15 with no continuation sheet.

defects.where: Page 1 Items 7, 8, 10, 11A, 11B and Page 2 Taxpayer's Name
defects.what: Long name, address, email, Other Party Name, and Item 11B TIN collide with comb ticks.

defects.where: Page 2 Continuation of Schedule 1.A and Schedule 1.B
defects.what: Numeric columns (Area, FMV per TD, FMV per BIR, Fair Market Value, TOTAL, Shares Sold, Par Value, DST Paid) are left-aligned flush against cell borders and 'COMMERCIAL' touches the right border of Classification.

defects.where: Page 2 Schedule 1.B Name of Corporate Stock
defects.what: Long corporate stock name shrinks to ~4.5pt single-line text instead of wrapping within the 2-line row height.
Official BIR 2000-OT Jan 2018 ENCS Page 2 includes the DST/ATC reference table (DO102/DO125/DO122) and the classification code legend (* RR-Residential Regular...); printed sheet omits both.

defects.where: Form navigation (between Part II and Part IV)
defects.what: Part III Details of Payment is absent from the screen form (jumps from Part II to Part IV), unlike 2551Q/2550Q/2000 which show Part III with read-only payment boxes.
66 field labels in forms/forms-schema.json are raw developer cell IDs (e.g. 'sched1A:txtOCTNo0', 'sched1A:txtTaxDecNo0', 'sched1A:txtLoc0') instead of plain-language labels.

shared_changes_wanted: neon-4 (try/forms-shared-print): comb-tick collisions; left-aligned schedule amounts with border clipping; blank items from missing joins if Item 1 / Schedule 2 Item B are join bugs
crates/bir-print (not yet on neon-4's list): overflow continuation sheet generation when 2000OT Schedule 1.A exceeds the 5 printed rows (currently rows 6-15 are silently dropped)
open_questions: Should the Page 2 DST/ATC reference table and classification legend be added to html-frozen/2000-ot-2018/?
